notes: Structure as living-room.json. category = Bible controlled vocabulary (textile, lighting, ceramics-tableware, storage-function, art-decor-toys); fixed-product furniture is storage-function. placement uses the product-card enum; placement_detail names the surface. z = layer order bottom to top; shadow at z-1 unless has_shadow_layer is false. Tie-break: product layers that share a z never overlap by design (if they do, the one nearer the camera goes on top); shadow layers are multiply and order-independent; no product shares its z with a shadow layer. plan_m in house coordinates, Z from the floor. envelope_cm = max envelope per variant; 3 variants within +-15%. frames = master frames where the product is visible by design. hotspot and zoom_frame after the shell render. fillers = unsold contents (Bible 1.5).

density.rule: Bible 1.7.1 S11: lean frame, minimum 11 is a floor; as many as the designer judges do not detract. Counted (rule D1, 2026-10-10, with user decision D1B, 2026-10-11) = a slot whose product is >= 50% visible and covers >= 0.5% of the frame; a set counts once; fixed-product furniture counts under the same rule (D1B: here desk, shelf and chair); not counted: neighbouring-room products, fillers, shell, fixed furniture that is not sold. A frame still short gets sold products from docs/proposals/density-after-d1.md (D1B). The counts below were estimated under the rejected 1.6 wording; the D1 counts in that proposal were measured without fixed-product: to re-measure with fixed-product counted (next clay).
